requirement.statement: The runtime SHALL parse and catalog-match the exact request, dispatch only by operation.ref, preserve single/selection/batch semantics, require every batch item to match one definition verb and subject shape, validate request choices against definition requestable ∩ binding actual ∩ server current, wrap same-datasource atomic work in the public outer transaction, reject cross-datasource atomic work before handlers, isolate homogeneous best-effort batch items without silently changing requested atomicity, and adapt update/delete RuntimeMutation values to an exact public Writer equality target derived from the compiled entity primary key; missing or invalid primary-key facts SHALL be rejected before Writer IO and SHALL NOT degrade to an unscoped mutation.

case.given: an unknown operation ref or exact request, preset, dimensions, verb, or batch shape inconsistent with catalog
case.then: no SQLite allocation, seed, or handler runs and stable validation diagnostics identify the path

case.given: a request choice excluded by the definition, binding, or server current capability set
case.then: the failing authority is reported and no SQLite allocation, seed, or handler runs

case.given: a composed handler performs two public Writer calls on one datasource and the second fails
case.then: the outer transaction rolls both writes back and response reports failure

case.given: a binding declares multiple datasources and request atomicity is atomic
case.then: CROSS_DATASOURCE_ATOMICITY_REJECTED is returned before any handler runs

case.given: homogeneous independently keyed batch items where one handler invocation fails
case.then: successful siblings commit, response is partial, and item keys map to independent statuses

case.given: a multi-row entity whose compiled primary key may not be named id
case.when: a handler submits update or delete values containing one valid key
case.then: only that row changes; sibling rows remain unchanged; create stays compatible; and missing or invalid key values fail before any unscoped Writer mutation
